### 1 — Scene
A light lunch: six maki sushi pieces, one fresh rice-paper roll, a chicken-and-shredded-vegetable salad, and a milky coffee.

### 2 — Vessels
Both plates appear approximately **22 cm in diameter**, giving each an area of **380 cm²**. The mug appears about **8 cm across internally**, giving a cross-sectional area of **50 cm²**.

### 3 — Items
Visible foods are filled maki rolls; a fresh rice-paper roll; cooked chicken; shredded cabbage; red pepper and carrot; a little coriander; a light salad dressing; and a foamy milk-based coffee. Exact fillings and dressing composition are uncertain.

### 4–6 — Area, volume and weight
Percentages below refer to each item's own plate. Dressing coats the salad rather than occupying a separate patch.

| Item | Vessel area covered | Area × average height = gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated weight |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Six maki pieces | 23% | 87 × 2.0 = 174 ml | 0.90 | 157 g |
| Fresh rice-paper roll | 15% | 57 × 1.6 = 91 ml | 0.95 | 87 g |
| Chicken | 25% | 95 × 1.1 = 105 ml | 0.95 | 100 g |
| Shredded cabbage | 43% | 163 × 3.0 = 489 ml | 0.18 | 88 g |
| Pepper and carrot | 8% | 30 × 1.0 = 30 ml | 0.60 | 18 g |
| Coriander | 1% | 4 × 1.5 = 6 ml | 0.15 | 1 g |
| Light dressing | Coating, no additional footprint | Approximately 10 ml | 1.00 | 10 g |
| Milky coffee | Mug cross-section | 50 × 4.5 = 225 ml | 0.98 | 220 g |

**Coverage check:** approximately **38% of the left plate** and **77% of the salad plate**. These allow for the broad rims and exposed plate around the food.

### 8 — Sanity check
The estimate is **461 g of food**, plus **220 g of coffee**, providing approximately **665 kcal altogether**. This is plausible for the visible portions. The largest uncertainties are the sushi fillings, dressing oil content, and milk proportion.
